content.text: TaskFlow employs a modern microservices architecture designed for scalability and maintainability. The system consists of a React Native mobile application, cloud-based API services, and a PostgreSQL database cluster.

content.code:
graph TD
    A[React Native App] --> B[API Gateway]
    B --> C[Authentication Service]
    B --> D[Task Management Service]
    B --> E[Notification Service]
    D --> F[(PostgreSQL Database)]
    C --> G[(User Database)]
    E --> H[Push Notification Provider]
    
    subgraph "AWS Cloud"
        B
        C
        D
        E
        F
        G
    end

content.text: The data layer consists of multiple PostgreSQL instances optimized for different workloads:

content.code:
erDiagram
    users {
        uuid id PK
        string email
        string name
        timestamp created_at
    }
    
    tasks {
        uuid id PK
        uuid user_id FK
        string title
        text description
        enum status
        timestamp due_date
        timestamp created_at
    }
    
    projects {
        uuid id PK
        uuid owner_id FK
        string name
        text description
        timestamp created_at
    }
    
    users ||--o{ tasks : creates
    users ||--o{ projects : owns
    projects ||--o{ tasks : contains
